description: This file contains Python test code for WebSocket functionality testing using pytest framework. It defines a test class 'TestWebsockets' with methods to check WebSocket server connectivity, manage a WebSocket echo server process, and perform various WebSocket client tests including ping-pong and data transmission tests.

classes.name: TestWebsockets
classes.description: A test class containing multiple methods to test WebSocket server and client functionality.

methods.name: check_alive(self, env, timeout=5)
methods.description: Checks if the WebSocket server is alive by attempting HTTP download requests within a timeout period.

methods.name: _mkpath(self, path)
methods.description: Creates the specified directory path if it does not exist.

methods.name: _rmrf(self, path)
methods.description: Removes the specified directory path if it exists.

methods.name: ws_echo(self, env)
methods.description: Fixture that sets up and tears down a WebSocket echo server process for tests.

methods.name: test_20_01_basic(self, env: Env, ws_echo, repeat)
methods.description: Tests basic WebSocket connectivity and expects a specific HTTP status code as response.

methods.name: test_20_02_pingpong_small(self, env: Env, ws_echo, repeat)
methods.description: Performs a small payload WebSocket ping-pong test to verify server response.

methods.name: test_20_03_pingpong_too_large(self, env: Env, ws_echo, repeat)
methods.description: Tests server behavior with a large control frame payload.

methods.name: test_20_04_data_small(self, env: Env, ws_echo, repeat)
methods.description: Tests data transfer with small payloads over WebSocket.

methods.name: test_20_05_data_med(self, env: Env, ws_echo, repeat)
methods.description: Tests data transfer with medium payloads over WebSocket.

methods.name: test_20_06_data_large(self, env: Env, ws_echo, repeat)
methods.description: Tests data transfer with large payloads over WebSocket.

methods.name: test_20_07_data_large_small_recv(self, env: Env, ws_echo, repeat)
methods.description: Tests large payload data transfer with specific WebSocket chunk size configuration.
